description: Adds the one TXT record that lets SecureSMTP sign email from this domain with DKIM. It sits on its own name under _domainkey and is only added: it does not conflict with, change or remove any other record.
variableDescription: %dkimkey%: the DKIM selector SecureSMTP assigned to this domain, for example securessmtp; %publickey%: the base64 DKIM public key SecureSMTP generated for this domain
